fusions.name: Resounding Slab
fusions.desc: Slams a slab across the front, which deals 12 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Seam Driver
fusions.desc: A thrust between the layers that deals 28 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Buttress
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage, up to 5 blows, for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Banded Ashlar
fusions.desc: Conjures stone armour: every hit you take deals 2 less damage, your armour rises by 10%, and your maximum health rises by 12.
